_help: Words for /testers/ (js/testers.js): becoming a tester and running tests. The rank needed and the coins are in test_tiers.json; the safety rules are also checked by the database (016_tests.sql).
title: Become a tester
intro: Try new web3 products before they launch, task by task, and tell the team where you got stuck.

perks.title: Paid in stablecoins
perks.text: Each approved test pays you in USDC or USDT, sent to your wallet after review.

perks.title: Coins
perks.text: Coins for every approved test (site points, no cash value).

perks.title: A Tester badge
perks.text: Shown on your My Progress page after your first approved test.

perks.title: Free full reports
perks.text: Every toy's full report is free while you are a tester.

rankLine: Testers need Explorer rank: earn {n} certificates first.
joinLine: Where should we send your stablecoins? Use a wallet you control. Double-check the network: payments sent to the wrong network cannot be recovered.
agree: I will only use testnets or a fresh, empty wallet, never real funds, and never enter a recovery phrase.
Payments are for the testing work I do, after the team reviews it. I am responsible for any taxes on them.
One account per person. Fake or rushed tests are not paid.

safety.text: I will use a testnet or a fresh, empty wallet only.
I will never use real funds.
I will never enter a recovery (seed) phrase anywhere.
If anything asks for a recovery phrase, I stop and report it.
I will keep everything about this product confidential, and take screenshots only inside the report, never to share elsewhere.

commentHint: What happened? Where did you look? (Never paste a recovery phrase or private key.)
